name: Resistor Environment QA 5
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Current through a resistor in a mixed circuit

examples.input: A circuit with 10V EMF contains a \SI{20}{\ohm} resistor in a parallel combination with \SI{5}{\ohm} and this subnetwork then connected in series with \SI{6}{\ohm}. What is the current through the \SI{20}{\ohm} resistor?
